# ShadTable

> ShadTable (https://www.shad-table.dev) is an open-source collection of copy-paste table components for shadcn/ui, built on TanStack Table. Each component is a shadcn registry item installed with `npx shadcn add https://www.shad-table.dev/r/<name>.json`, so the code lives in your own project.

Every page below has a live demo, the full source, an install command, and a step-by-step "How it works" explanation.

- Source: https://github.com/coros-hq/shadcn-table-library
- Registry index: https://www.shad-table.dev/r/registry.json

## Data Table

- [Data Table](https://www.shad-table.dev/data-table): A data table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A sortable, filterable, paginated table with a composable toolbar for column filters — filtering and sorting run entirely client-side via TanStack Table. Includes React and Vue (@tanstack/vue-table) source.
- [Migrating from TanStack Table v8 to v9](https://www.shad-table.dev/migrate-v9): A practical v8 to v9 migration guide for shadcn/ui tables with before and after code for feature registration, row models, types, sortFn, state, column pinning and selection, plus a checklist.

## SSR

- [Pagination](https://www.shad-table.dev/server-table): A server-side pagination table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Only the current page's rows are ever sent to the browser — changing pages triggers a real server request instead of slicing an in-memory array.
- [Filter](https://www.shad-table.dev/server-filter): A server-side filtering table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Filtering by column, resolved on the server the same way SSR Pagination resolves pages — every filter change is a real server request, not an in-memory slice.
- [Sort + Filter + Pagination](https://www.shad-table.dev/server-combined-table): A server-side sorting, filtering and pagination table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Sorting, filtering, and pagination all resolved together on the server from one URL, instead of three separate demos — the way real dashboards actually work.

## Advanced Filters

- [Toolbar Filter Table](https://www.shad-table.dev/toolbar-filter-table): A toolbar filter table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A simple filter row above the table — dropdown selects and a search input, filters applied immediately. The 80% use case for filtering.
- [Filter State Shape](https://www.shad-table.dev/filter-state-shape-table): A data table filter state pattern for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A normalized ActiveFilter[] array as the single source of truth for multi-select and date-range filters, keeping the toolbar, chips row, and columnFilters in sync.
- [Filter Toolbar](https://www.shad-table.dev/filter-toolbar-table): A config-driven data table filter toolbar for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A config-driven filter system — filters are generated from column.meta instead of being hand-wired per column, with an active-filters row derived from columnFilters.
- [Params Filter Table](https://www.shad-table.dev/params-filter-table): A data table with URL search params filters for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A data table whose filter state is synced to URL search params.
- [Deployments](https://www.shad-table.dev/deployments-table): A deployments table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A deployment history table like on hosting platforms: status with build time, environment, branch and commit, with filters for environment, status, branch, and date and live counts on every option.
- [Logs](https://www.shad-table.dev/logs-table): A log explorer table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: a date range picker, multi-select level, service, and status filters, highlighted search, and expandable rows with the full event.

## Structure / Hierarchy

- [Tree Table](https://www.shad-table.dev/tree-table): A tree table for nested rows for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A hierarchical table for nested data — departments, teams, and employees — with expand/collapse, sorting, and a search box that keeps a matching row\
- [Grouped Table](https://www.shad-table.dev/grouped-table): A grouped table with row grouping for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Orders grouped by category, with collapsible group headers and a live subtotal of each group's order amounts.
- [Pivot Table](https://www.shad-table.dev/pivot-table): A pivot table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Dashboard-style analytics table — pick which dimension becomes rows, which becomes columns, and how to aggregate (sum, average, or count), recomputed from flat sales data.
- [Master-Detail Table](https://www.shad-table.dev/master-detail): A master-detail table with expandable rows for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Expand an order to reveal its shipping address and a nested sub-table of line items — a full-width detail row rendered directly beneath the row that owns it.

## Interaction-heavy

- [Tree Table — Selection](https://www.shad-table.dev/tree-select): A tree table with checkbox selection for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. The same department/team/employee tree, with a checkbox column that cascades selection to every descendant and reports indeterminate state for partial branches.
- [Tree Table — Reorder](https://www.shad-table.dev/tree-reorder): A drag-and-drop tree table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. The same department/team/employee tree, with rows draggable by a handle — reordering is scoped to siblings so a department can't be dropped inside a team.
- [Reorderable Table](https://www.shad-table.dev/reorder-table): A drag-and-drop reorderable table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Drag rows to reorder them, built on @dnd-kit/sortable rather than any table-specific drag logic.
- [Editable Table](https://www.shad-table.dev/editable-table): An editable data table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Click a cell to edit it inline. Edits validate on commit, apply optimistically, roll back on a simulated failure, and can be undone one at a time.
- [Resizable / Reorderable Columns](https://www.shad-table.dev/resizable-table): A table with resizable and reorderable columns for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Drag a header's grip to reorder columns, drag its right edge to resize — the resulting layout is saved to localStorage and restored on your next visit.
- [Column Pinning](https://www.shad-table.dev/column-pinning-table): A column pinning table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Excel/AG Grid–style column pinning: freeze columns to the left or right edge while the rest of the table scrolls underneath.
- [Inventory Allocation](https://www.shad-table.dev/inventory-allocation-table): An inventory allocation table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. An editable inventory grid with expandable batch detail and live formula columns — reorder point, days of cover, and suggested PO recalculate as you edit demand, lead time, or batch allocations.
- [Infinite Scroll](https://www.shad-table.dev/infinite-scroll-table): An infinite scroll table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Loads the next page as you scroll with an IntersectionObserver sentinel, skeleton loading rows, inline retry on errors, and a sticky header. Includes React and Vue source.
- [Excel-like Table](https://www.shad-table.dev/spreadsheet-table): An Excel-like spreadsheet table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A1 headers, keyboard navigation, range selection, type-to-edit, copy and paste, and formulas such as SUM and AVERAGE that recalculate as you edit. Includes React and Vue source.

## Animated

- [Animated Icons Table](https://www.shad-table.dev/animated-icons-table): A table with animated row-action icons for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Row actions built with Iconimate — motion-driven icons that animate on hover, focus, and click, wired to favorite, notify, archive, and delete.
- [Live Status Indicators](https://www.shad-table.dev/live-status-table): A live status table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A service-health table where status and latency update live on a timer, with a pulsing indicator for actively-monitored states.
- [Async Row Actions](https://www.shad-table.dev/async-actions-table): A table with async row actions for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Table row actions with animated icons that reflect real request state: a sync icon that spins while pending, Retry on failure, Undo for archive, and a confirm step for delete.

## Dashboard / Analytics-specific

- [Summary / KPI Table](https://www.shad-table.dev/kpi-table): A KPI summary table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A compact metrics table — current value, period-over-period change, and a per-row sparkline — for the kind of dashboard summary that sits above the fold.
- [Comparison Table](https://www.shad-table.dev/comparison-table): A comparison table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Pricing plans as table columns — feature rows compare booleans and values across every plan, with the recommended plan's column tinted to stand out.
- [Heatmap Table](https://www.shad-table.dev/heatmap-table): A heatmap table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Revenue by region and month, with each cell's background intensity mapped to its value — spot patterns across a matrix at a glance instead of reading numbers.
- [Conditional Formatting](https://www.shad-table.dev/conditional-formatting-table): A conditional formatting table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. Excel-style conditional formatting: a small rule engine highlights cells, colors text, and re-colors badges based on the row data, not just a single value.
- [Production Dashboard](https://www.shad-table.dev/production-dashboard-table): A production dashboard table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A production-line dashboard combining conditional formatting, progress bars, and sparklines on one realistic dataset — a composition of existing primitives, not a new feature.

## Export / Density Variants

- [Density & Export](https://www.shad-table.dev/utility-table): A table with a density toggle and export for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. One table, three modes: a compact/comfortable/spacious density toggle, CSV/Excel/PDF export, and a print-optimized view that ignores dark mode entirely.
- [Export Configuration](https://www.shad-table.dev/export-config-table): A table with configurable CSV and Excel export for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A table whose Export button opens a dialog: filter by status, region, and date, pick columns and CSV or Excel, and see a live count of matching rows before downloading.
- [Export Selected Rows](https://www.shad-table.dev/export-selected-table): A table that exports selected rows for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A table with row checkboxes that exports only the selected rows to CSV or Excel. Selection persists across pages, with a page-level select-all and a "Select all" shortcut.

## Responsive

- [Mobile Cards Table](https://www.shad-table.dev/mobile-cards-table): A responsive table that becomes cards on mobile for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table. A data table that transforms into stacked cards below a container-query breakpoint using pure CSS display overrides — no separate mobile component, no JS media query, no viewport dependency.

<!-- v9:start -->
## TanStack Table v9 versions

Every example above is also available for @tanstack/react-table v9. Install it by adding `-v9` to the name, for example `npx shadcn add https://www.shad-table.dev/r/tree-table-v9.json`.

- [Shadcn Table with Animated Icons (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/animated-icons-table): Table with animated row-action icons for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: favorite, notify, archive and delete with Iconimate. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Table with Async Row Actions (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/async-actions-table): Shadcn table row actions that show real request state: spinning sync, Retry on failure, Undo for archive, confirm for delete. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Table Column Pinning (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/column-pinning-table): Column pinning for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: freeze columns to the left or right edge, Excel-style, while the rest scrolls. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Comparison Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/comparison-table): Pricing comparison table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: plans as columns, features as rows, recommended plan highlighted. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Conditional Formatting Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/conditional-formatting-table): Excel-style conditional formatting for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: a small rule engine colors cells and badges from row data. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Data Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/data-table): Sortable, filterable, paginated data table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table with a composable filter toolbar. React and Vue code. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Deployments Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/deployments-table): Deployments table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: build status, environment, branch and commit, with live-count filters. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Editable Table (Inline Editing) (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/editable-table): Inline-editable data table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: validation, optimistic updates, rollback and undo. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Table Export to CSV & Excel (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/export-config-table): Export a shadcn/ui table to CSV or Excel: choose rows by filter, pick columns, and see a live row count before you download. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Table — Export Selected Rows (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/export-selected-table): Export only selected rows to CSV or Excel from a shadcn/ui and TanStack Table table; selection persists across pages. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Data Table Filter State (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/filter-state-shape-table): Data table filter state for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: one ActiveFilter[] array keeps toolbar, chips and columnFilters in sync. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Data Table Filter Toolbar (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/filter-toolbar-table): Config-driven filter toolbar for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: filters generated from column.meta with an active-filters row. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Grouped Table (Row Grouping) (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/grouped-table): Row grouping for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: collapsible group headers with live subtotals per group. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Heatmap Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/heatmap-table): Heatmap table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: cell color intensity follows the value, so patterns show at a glance. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Infinite Scroll Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/infinite-scroll-table): Infinite scroll table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: IntersectionObserver loading, skeleton rows, retry on error, sticky header. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Inventory Allocation Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/inventory-allocation-table): Editable inventory table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table with batch detail and live formula columns like days of cover. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn KPI / Summary Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/kpi-table): KPI summary table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: current value, period-over-period change and a sparkline per row. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Table with Live Status Indicators (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/live-status-table): Live status table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: status and latency update on a timer with pulsing indicators. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Logs Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/logs-table): Log explorer table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: date range, level, service and status filters, search highlight, expandable rows. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Master-Detail Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/master-detail): Master-detail table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: expandable rows reveal details and a nested sub-table of line items. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Responsive Table (Mobile Cards) (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/mobile-cards-table): Responsive table that turns into cards on mobile for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table, using only CSS container queries. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Table with URL Params Filters (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/params-filter-table): Data table with filters synced to URL search params for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: shareable and back-button friendly. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Pivot Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/pivot-table): Pivot table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: choose row and column dimensions, then sum, average or count flat data. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Production Dashboard Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/production-dashboard-table): Production dashboard table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table combining conditional formatting, progress bars and sparklines. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Drag-and-Drop Reorderable Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/reorder-table): Drag-and-drop reorderable table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table, built on @dnd-kit/sortable. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Resizable Columns Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/resizable-table): Resizable and reorderable columns for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table, with the layout saved to localStorage. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Server Sort, Filter, Pagination (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/server-combined-table): Server-side sorting, filtering and pagination for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table, all driven from one URL. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Server-Side Filtering Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/server-filter): Server-side filtering table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: every filter change is a real server request, driven by the URL. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Server-Side Pagination Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/server-table): Server-side pagination table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: only the current page's rows are sent to the browser. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Excel-like Spreadsheet Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/spreadsheet-table): Excel-like spreadsheet table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: keyboard navigation, ranges, copy and paste, SUM and AVERAGE formulas. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Toolbar Filter Table (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/toolbar-filter-table): Toolbar filter table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: dropdown selects and a search input above the table. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Tree Table with Drag Reorder (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/tree-reorder): Drag-and-drop tree table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: reorder rows among siblings with a drag handle. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Tree Table with Checkbox Selection (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/tree-select): Tree table with checkbox selection for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: cascading selection and indeterminate parents. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Tree Table (Nested Rows) (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/tree-table): Tree table for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table: nested rows, expand/collapse, sorting, search, product variants and a detail card. For TanStack Table v9.
- [Shadcn Table Density Toggle & Export (v9)](https://www.shad-table.dev/v9/utility-table): Table density toggle and CSV, Excel or PDF export for shadcn/ui and TanStack Table, with a print-friendly view. For TanStack Table v9.
